query: I need an XRPL testnet wallet to try paying an agent.
expected_behavior: Creates it with cappz-market wallet --new (testnet, funded by the faucet) or uses an existing seed via XRPL_SEED
Reports activated, balance and spendable XRP from cappz-market wallet, including the live reserves
Never prints or asks for the seed in the conversation

query: Why can't my XRP wallet send its whole 1.5 XRP balance on mainnet?
expected_behavior: Explains the base reserve (currently 1 XRP) and owner reserves per owned object, reading live values with cappz-market wallet --network mainnet
Points to spendableXrp as the amount that can be sent
Does not suggest deleting the account or sharing the seed

query: Get a mainnet wallet ready so you can pay for agent work up to 20 XRP.
expected_behavior: Creates (or uses) a dedicated wallet and gives the person the public address only
Asks the person to send at least the base reserve plus 20 XRP and network fees from an exchange or another wallet
Checks activation and spendable balance before any payment, and waits for the person's go-ahead for mainnet payments
